Food paradise.
Jan 2026 • Couples
If you are looking for a dining experience you won’t forget this is the place whilst in HCMC. Staff are exceptional, dining room is beautiful and the buffet is world class. We were surprised when we booked for two on the internet with drinks included that it was so inexpensive. After seeing what was on offer we were shocked by the price and standard. Lobsters cooked to your choice and delivered to the table. Lamb chops cooked to your choice and delivered to your table. Delicious sushi, scallops on pea purée. A wide selection of seafood including mussels, scallops, prawns and crab. Sallads, matured hams a wide selection of baked breads and crackers. A wide range of desserts and ice cream along with coffee and fruit. If you check out my photographs you will see how good the food was. All drinks were included wine, beer and cocktails made with international spirits not local cheaper stuff. It was so good we knew we couldn’t get better for the next evening so we booked again. Romantic settings a definite must when in Saigon.

Incredible All You Can Eat Seafood Buffet :)
Dec 2025 • Solo
Came here for the weekend all you can eat seafood buffet and had an amazing 5 star experience.

Wide selection of amazing foods from oysters to lobster prepared 4 ways to lamb chops, amazing selection of cheeses. They also had fine dining plated dishes too such as scallops, pan seared duck, salmon crudo - everything was top quality and it was definitely worth the price of $55 USD with tax and tip included.

While the food was amazing, what stood out even more was the impeccable service. All of the wait staff and especially my specific server named Long were kind, friendly, and attentive - they were constantly checking on me to make sure my meal was going well and they were very good at making sure the table was cleared.

If you want a 5 star dining experience at one of the nicest dining rooms in Saigon (the decor and atmosphere is beautiful) - look no further than the Parkview Restaurant weekend seafood buffet (Fri & Sat 6-10 PM) 😊

Truly Remarkable Experience
Oct 2023 • Family
We had a large family buffet dinner at the Parkview.
To say it was amazing is an understatement. Everything from the salads to the sushi to the seafood, was incredibly fresh and delicious. 
I particularly loved the small plates and single pieces that gave you a taste of elegance. The lobsters came out on the half you did not hav3e to pull it out of the shell, they did that cut it up so that it was very easy to eat with no mess. That in itself showed attention to detail, that I did not find in other 5 star buffets. We were also able to order items on the right at the table, which made a big difference with our large table.
The staff was very attentive and when we ordered a drink, they would bring that AND another drink to try that they thought I would like. I DID !!

But the even got even better for me. As a chef, I always love taking to the staff and managers, but when the Executive Chef Fabio Vitale, (from Napoli) came out to greet us and we talked food, well, I found a kindred soul. An amazing man, I would be proud to call a friend.

Later we spoke to the restaurant manager Ms. Nguyen Thi Hong Yen, who was the sweetest person and made sure our visit was perfect.
There was also a supervisor on the floor and I am sorry I cannot remember his name, but he was always close by to ensure we were well taken care of.

I know this review may sound like a promotion for the restaurant, but I assure you, I had never been to the place in my life. I just believe that when you have a wonderful experience like we had that it should be acknowledged and if you have read some of my other reviews, you know I do not hold back, positive or negative.

Cake boxes at Patisserie
Oct 2020
I am posting here as I don't see a separate page for the lounge. I recently bought a chocolate cake from the hotel's patisserie. The cake was good but very rich; I thought it was going to have cake mixture inside but is was more like a rich mousse so we could only eat a small piece. When ordering from Phung, the staff at the lounge, she offered excellent customer service, friendly, bubbly and very helpful - definitely an asset to the team. The only problem was the design of the cake box. An 8-inch cake is paired with a 9-inch or so box. So they staff had trouble fitting it in the box, not their fault. Worse was at the restaurant trying to get the cake out of the box, as the restaurant would most definitely get their fingers all over the cake, they had to cut open the box as it wasn't a typical cake box with sides that open. So the box was destroyed and we had to carry the leftover cake home in a bag. While it provided some comic relief, it was a bit embarrassing for a special occasion. Not exactly up to expectations, I would strongly suggest to change the box design and get ones that fit different sizes of cakes.

"Okay" Dinner Buffett But Overpriced
May 2020
Any buffet that charges extra for each non-alcoholic drink you order is not a real buffet. It's a scam. The food variety was okay but considering the price (over $60) the selection was inadequate. The food quality was just okay. The service was good (probably because there was not many people there which might also explain why the food quality is not better). In my opinion, the buffet is overpriced by nearly 2-fold considering what you get. Bottom line: would I return? Not likely. I'll probably pay a little more and go where I know I will not be disappointed (one of the major hotel brands - Park Hyatt, Sheraton, Reverie, etc.).

Rambo

The buffet dinner was priced on the steep side but the food was varied and thoroughly inviting. I particularly enjoyed the lobster, grilled sailfish, lotus salad, and green curry river prawn. Above all, I appreciated the patron-friendly and enthusiastic sous chef, Rambo, who took the trouble to explain the story behind some of the dishes I was eyeing and even volunteered and cooked for me a garlic prawn dish which was off-menu. Rambo's presence more than made up for any shortcoming the restaurant might have had.
